headline: 2 arrested in Barishal for assaulting MD and forcing cheque signing
summary: The suspects, including Mostafizur Rahman Litu, allegedly assaulted a real estate company's MD and coerced him into signing a Tk 70 lakh cheque.
details: Two people, including Mostafizur Rahman Litu, were arrested in Barishal today after a court order. They are accused of assaulting a real estate company's managing director and forcing him to sign a cheque and several stamp papers.
The victim, Abdul Aziz Hawlader, Managing Director of Agrani Housing Limited, alleged that he was physically assaulted and threatened at his office on Sadar Road on Thursday evening.
Hawlader claimed he was compelled to sign six stamp papers and a cheque worth Tk 70 lakh. He immediately informed his bank to prevent the encashment of the cheque.
The incident was captured on CCTV footage that has since gone viral on social media, showing men confronting and slapping the MD in his office.
According to the victim, Litu was a former business partner. He claimed that all financial matters had been settled in 2023, but Litu continued to demand Tk 1 crore.
While locals associate Litu with the Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, the organization's metropolitan unit has denied any affiliation with him.
The case involves seven named accused, including Litu, and 10 to 15 unidentified individuals. Police are continuing their investigation into the matter.
caption:
A real estate MD was allegedly assaulted and forced to sign a Tk 70 lakh cheque—the incident was caught on CCTV.

Two people, including Mostafizur Rahman Litu, were arrested in Barishal today after a court order. They are accused of assaulting a real estate company's managing director and forcing him to sign a cheque and several stamp papers.

The victim, Abdul Aziz Hawlader, Managing Director of Agrani Housing Limited, alleged that he was physically assaulted and threatened at his office on Sadar Road on Thursday evening.

Hawlader claimed he was compelled to sign six stamp papers and a cheque worth Tk 70 lakh. He immediately informed his bank to prevent the encashment of the cheque.

The incident was captured on CCTV footage that has since gone viral on social media, showing men confronting and slapping the MD in his office.

According to the victim, Litu was a former business partner. He claimed that all financial matters had been settled in 2023, but Litu continued to demand Tk 1 crore.

While locals associate Litu with the Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, the organization's metropolitan unit has denied any affiliation with him.

The case involves seven named accused, including Litu, and 10 to 15 unidentified individuals. Police are continuing their investigation into the matter.

Source: Somoy News, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline: 2 arrested for killing youth over 20 lakh taka extortion in Noakhali
summary: RAB-11 arrested two suspects from Dhaka after a 23-year-old man was killed with iron rods and cleavers following a dispute over extortion money.
details: RAB-11 has arrested two suspects in connection with the murder of 23-year-old Jobayer Hossain, also known as Rakib, in Noakhali's Begumganj upazila.
The arrests took place on Saturday afternoon in the Rampura and Badda areas of Dhaka.

According to RAB, the victim's father and uncle were jointly constructing a five-story building in Khanpur village. During the construction, the suspects demanded 20 lakh taka in extortion money from Rakib.
When Rakib expressed his inability to provide the money from his uncle, a dispute ensued between the parties.
On May 30, while Rakib was returning home, the suspects allegedly attacked him with iron rods and cleavers in the Pakmunsirhat area of Sharifpur union.
Rakib was rushed to Noakhali 250-bed General Hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.
A murder case has been filed by the victim's mother at the Begumganj police station.
The arrested suspects, identified as Suman and Piyas, have been handed over to the Hatirjheel police station in Dhaka for further legal action.
